rooms.name: The Hall
rooms.description: A narrow hallway runs through the heart of the house. Doors branch to every room. The front door sits at the end, daylight outlining its frame.

objects.name: Coat Rack
objects.description: A wooden coat rack hung with a few jackets and an umbrella.

objects.name: Mirror
objects.description: A tall mirror leans against the wall near the front door. You look tired.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.description: A comfortable room with a worn sofa facing a large screen. Warm light filters through curtained windows. Bookshelves line the far wall.

objects.name: Sofa
objects.description: A deep, worn sofa with mismatched cushions. Extremely comfortable.

objects.name: Screen
objects.description: A large flat screen mounted on the wall. Currently off.

objects.name: Coffee Table
objects.description: A low table with a few scattered books and an empty mug.

objects.name: Bookshelf
objects.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with paperbacks and a few framed photos.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A compact kitchen that smells of coffee. A back door leads out to the yard. Sunlight comes through a small window above the sink.

objects.name: Countertop
objects.description: A clean countertop with a coffee maker and a few dishes drying beside the sink.

objects.name: Kitchen Table
objects.description: A small round table with two chairs.

objects.name: Back Door
objects.description: A plain wooden back door. Through its glass panel you can see the back yard.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.description: A quiet room with a large bed, curtains drawn against the light. A wardrobe stands against one wall. The bathroom is just through the side door.

objects.name: Bed
objects.description: A large bed with rumpled covers and too many pillows.

objects.name: Wardrobe
objects.description: A tall wardrobe. Clothes hang inside in approximate order.

objects.name: Nightstand
objects.description: A small nightstand with a lamp, a glass of water, and a paperback left face-down.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.description: A small but tidy bathroom. White tiles, a fogged mirror above the sink, and a claw-foot bathtub along the far wall.

objects.name: Bathtub
objects.description: A claw-foot cast-iron tub. Someone has left a rubber duck on the edge.

objects.name: Sink
objects.description: A pedestal sink with a fogged mirror above it.

objects.name: Medicine Cabinet
objects.description: A small cabinet behind the mirror. It is politely closed.

rooms.name: Office
rooms.description: You are sitting at the desk. The monitor glows a steady green in the quiet room. Behind it, a window looks out onto the yard. To your left, a floating shelf â€” the cat is asleep on it, one paw hanging over the edge. To your right, a bookshelf. The rest of the house waits beyond the door.

objects.name: Desk
objects.description: A wide desk positioned beneath the window. Papers, a keyboard, and a steaming mug occupy its surface.

objects.name: KleinBOTTLE PC
objects.description: A compact machine on the desk. Its monitor glows a steady green. This is it. This is the computer.

objects.name: Floating Shelf
objects.description: A wall-mounted shelf to the left of the desk. The cat fills it completely.

objects.name: Window
objects.description: A wide window directly behind the desk. Outside, the yard stretches to the treeline.

objects.name: Bookshelf
objects.description: A tall bookshelf to the right of the desk, packed with technical manuals, notebooks, and a few worn novels.

objects.name: Cat
objects.description: A large tabby cat occupies the floating shelf like it was built for exactly that purpose. One eye is half-open. It is judging you.

actors.name: Cat
actors.description: A grey cat is curled up on the floating shelf, deeply asleep. One paw hangs over the edge.

rooms.name: Front Yard
rooms.description: A neat front yard wraps around the front of the house. Flagstones lead from the front door to a large iron gate in the garden wall. The house stands behind you.

objects.name: Front Gate
objects.description: A large iron gate, slightly rusty at the hinges. It opens with a satisfying clank.

objects.name: Garden Path
objects.description: Flagstones set into neat grass, running from the front door to the gate.

rooms.name: Back Yard
rooms.description: A quiet back yard. A vegetable patch runs along the fence. A small wooden gate in the far corner leads into the trees.

objects.name: Back Gate
objects.description: A small wooden gate, worn smooth. It opens quietly on well-oiled hinges.

objects.name: Vegetable Patch
objects.description: Raised beds with tomatoes, herbs, and something leafy you don't recognise.

rooms.name: Wooded Path
rooms.description: A narrow path winds between tall trees. Roots cross the ground, light filters green through the canopy. The path loops around the property â€” you can hear the back of the house through the trees ahead.

objects.name: Old Oak
objects.description: A very old oak. Its bark is carved with initials too faded to read.

rooms.name: Wooded Path
rooms.description: The path curves back toward the house. Through the trees you can see the back fence and the small wooden gate. The path continues around to the front if you keep going.

objects.name: Mossy Rock
objects.description: A large flat rock covered in soft moss. Someone has left a coffee cup on it.
